appearance.identity: Golden dragon crossing with three arches, five-tube body, dorsal plates, east-facing layered head and western fan tail.
appearance.exclusions: Exact fasteners, fire/water effects, banners, traffic and underwater construction.

brief: Compact original Dragon Bridge reconstruction: budgeted tubular arches, folded head/tail silhouette, hangers, lower concrete arches, roadway, sidewalks and sparse rails/lights. Original detailed master preserved independently.

sourceFacts.source: Chinh et al., E3S Web of Conferences10,00106(2016), sections2.1–2.4 and figures6–15; WSP/ASME designer account; Da Nang city report.
sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original817800-triangle/64532088-byte master reproduced exactly; separate medium-fi source retains visible dragon geometry with fewer subdivisions and PMTiles approach fit.

geographic.notes: Inspected one elevated daytime picture: three yellow tube arches, folded scales, layered east-facing head, broad road deck and side promenades. Standard viewer PMTiles confirms the east/west crossing across Han River. Retain666m authored extent and the existing provisional38.3m westward origin correction; the coarse760.74m map polygon includes extra approaches and is not used to stretch the bridge. West/east PMTiles approaches4.0784/7.8028m give approximatebase-3.1216m and browser deck endpoints7.2/10.9244m; a5m rise between them is reconstructed. River surface0m and submerged pier bases are approximate. Exact tide, engineering vertical curve, terminal joins and head plate outlines remain unverified.

Original detailed master remains independently reproducible. Medium-fi derivatives simplify individual tubes at skyline/district distance and omit bolts, dense rail infill, triple hanger rods and decorative light curls. Closer models retain five arch tubes and the layered reconstructed head; shared painted/stainless metal, concrete and fired clay are reused.
Approximate geometry/color agreement from one picture and PMTiles is sufficient for this visualization scope; no bespoke survey or research campaign. Physical-device timings remain unmeasured.
